facts.fact: Chad's reply to UNESCO's 2023 SDG 16.10.2 survey names Ordonnance 16/PR/2018 and Law 10-017 on the press regime as primary legislation guaranteeing access to information.

The survey reply says the law provides a dedicated national oversight body, a converged data protection and access to information body, which in 2022 published an annual report, gave guidance and training, and raised awareness.

TCD.note: Document states nothing this study asks for this country.

facts.fact: The survey reply says a national converged body combining data protection and access to information oversight exists, its head appointed by a college of executive, judiciary, legislature and journalists, and it was active in 2022.

Survey marks any open government or open data strategy as N/A; no policy stated.
